text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly selling Stock B at lower prices and then buying it back did not create a clear edge; define what would change my view before trading and avoid chasing recent moves.","Review the portfolio as a whole, including cash and concentration, rather than making isolated stock-by-stock decisions; the account’s overall decline matters more than any single trade’s profit or loss.","Use a consistent, evidence-based process for entries and exits, and reassess it over time instead of letting recent gains or losses dictate the next decision."]}
